svg.text: Server Architecture Diagram · FastAPI 0.x · Next.js 16.2 · Google ADK · PuLP / Gurobi · 2026-05-12
APPLICATION GATEWAY — FastAPI 0.x · CORS Middleware · port :8000
Router Registry (backend/api/) · Session resolved via X-Session-Id header → backend/deps.py
← all routes share the same CORS origin policy (SOCA_CORS_ORIGINS env var)
Session middleware injects problem_state from SessionStore into every handler via Depends(get_session)
In-memory per-session problem_state dict · keyed by X-Session-Id
Replaces st.session_state for the FastAPI path
Async pub/sub · fans activity-log + tool events to SSE subscribers
Published by ADK tools · consumed by /api/events/stream
Tool Registry — ADK Structured Function Calling
Inspects problem_state["data"] · reports loaded dataset summary
Drop-one re-solve · per-facility objective degradation report
sensitivity_tools.py · reuses cached road graph + data_dict
Gurobi (preferred) → PuLP / CBC (fallback) · geodesic auto-fallback when road graph unavailable
Token-bucket rate limiter · Exponential backoff 1 s → 2 s → 4 s · Nominatim 1 req/s ToS
overture_duckdb.py · overture_release.py — DuckDB queries against Overture Maps public S3 release
OSMnx road-network graph · LRU cache (cap = 3 sessions)
Lazy fetch · daemon prefetch thread spawned on AOI confirm
Road-network shortest path is the default distance_metric for all four solvers
Geodesic auto-fallback if graph unavailable at solve time (warn attached to result)
